description: MISP star scenario: one instructor hub + one spoke per team (2 teams), one SDN vnet per team, deployed from the misp-star catalog element (range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/misp-star/) and paired spoke-to-hub by MISP sync via the shared bundle bundles/admin/software.install.misp_star/. The star IS the workload (always deployed, no INSTALL flag for it). Hub admin-misp-star-hub (VMID 1195, 192.168.142.195, net142); spokes misp-star-spoke-01 (team-01, VMID 1196, 192.168.149.196, net149) and misp-star-spoke-02 (team-02, VMID 1197, 192.168.150.197, net150). Optional admin-wazuh VM (VMID 1198, IP 192.168.142.198, net142, gated by INSTALL_WAZUH, default off) deploys a Wazuh SIEM server + agents on the 3 star VMs.
